drag_catwalk.name: The Floor Is Yours — Drag Catwalk
drag_catwalk.description: A level runway with four dressed walking agents. Performers walk a bounded two-lane circuit, turn, pose and yield to the visitor. Hold/Play pauses their local show; Swap Looks cycles the same four outfits worn by the player. Cosmetic agents never write player progression or appearance.
interactions: Walk the runway alongside the performers
drag_catwalk.qfep_connection: A repeated route carries different silhouettes. Yielding makes room for another body within the same choreography, without treating that body as an enemy.
